author: David Bombal
description:
Think your PC has been hacked? We discuss Microsoft Sysinternals, a Wireshark DNS filter, and what Windows network activity can reveal about your computer's connections.

Thank you to ThreatLocker for sponsoring this video and my trip to Black Hat USA.

title: Think Your PC Is Hacked? Start Here

author: David Bombal
description:
Big thanks to Cisco & Splunk for sponsoring my trip to .Conf 2026 and also for sponsoring this video.    

This F1 dashboard is running in Splunk. Robert shows me how F1 2025 sends telemetry from a racing simulator to the cloud, where custom visualizations bring the race to life with about a 1.5-second delay in this demo. 

We follow the data from the game’s built-in UDP telemetry through a collector written in Go. The collector converts the data into JSON and batch uploads it into Splunk, powering dashboards for speed, RPM, steering input, tire and brake temperatures, simulated G-force, race events and track position. 

Then we look at the post-race analysis. By comparing laps and braking inputs, Robert shows where a driver is improving and where there may be time to gain. You can see how the data becomes something useful: feedback for the next run on the simulator.
